829052_hitter.text: Breyson Guedez is a young left-handed hitter working through strikeout noise at the A level, flashing contact ability (.282 avg, 83rd percentile) but generating minimal power (.119 ISO, 31st percentile) and very little leverage on base (6.6% BB rate, 8th percentile). 829058_hitter.text: Gabriel Davalillo is an 18-year-old third baseman showing mixed bat discipline and pop: he's posting .267/.348/.410 with an 11% walk rate and .143 ISO over 227 A-ball plate appearances, though both his strikeout rate (25.6%) and isolated power rank near the middle of the minor-league field. The real concern is that his average and slugging power lag below the tools expected at the position—his .267 AVG is strong for his age, but ISO in the 47th percentile signals he hasn't yet connected the bat to game power. The sample is current and meaningful, but at 18 with moderate command and modest thump so far, this looks like a years-away organizational depth profile rather than a near-term contributor.

829210_hitter.text: Ty Harvey is a 19-year-old catcher showing early discipline at the plate—19% BB% on a 58 PA sample—but swinging and missing at a concerning clip (24.1% K%). The sample is small and fresh, so expect volatility as he faces stiffer velocity and sequencing.

829854_hitter.text: Luis Arana is an 18-year-old A-level shortstop who commands the strike zone exceptionally—posting 19.2% BB% over 78 PA—but whose overall bat lacks impact, evidenced by a modest .127 ISO and a .460 SLG despite the strong .462 OBP. The approach grade is elite relative to his peer group; the hit tool is solid; but power and overall impact are well below average, and that power ceiling is the central constraint. At 78 plate appearances in a current season sample, confidence in the profile is limited, though the plate discipline suggests a repeatable skill.

830239_hitter.text: The ISO is the argument: .243 at A+ over 331 plate appearances, which translates to .159 at the MLB level, right at league average for raw power despite coming from a 22-year-old center fielder.
